.tura/media\03-The-Grub-Files-Cooking-with-Camissonia-Squid-with.md-19-'You Yu Geng' (that's the mandarin pronunciation - I won't even try to phoneticize the Taiwanese pronunciation), is basically julienned squid wrapped in a fish paste, and it's the star in the traditional slightly sweet & sour soup called 'Geng,' loaded with assorted veggies like sliced shiitake mushrooms, bamboo shoots, carrots, wood ear fungus, seasoned with black vinegar, and then thickened with a cornstarch slurry. There's another iteration using pork instead of squid ('Rou Geng'), which can be substituted for the squid version in this recipe. If you don't have a Chinese market in your neck of the woods that stocks this ingredient, then I can't help you. I know you can make fish paste from scratch, but I'm not one who does. So there.

.tura/media\03-The-Grub-Files-Cooking-with-Camissonia-Squid-with.md:22:Ingredients: 2 quarts of water (16 cups) 4 tbsp. chicken base (Totole brand chicken powder is the best) 1/3 bunch of cilantro, chopped 1/2 lb. of imitation crab 1 tsp. white pepper 1 tbsp. sesame oil 3 tbsp. sugar 1 medium carrot, julienned 1 pkg of vacuum-sealed bamboo shoots (use canned if you can't get these, but these taste better) 6 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked in hot water & then sliced 1 cup of dried, shredded wood ear fungus, soaked in hot water to soften 1 pkg (around 3/4 lb.) of squid with fish paste
.tura/media\03-The-Grub-Files-Cooking-with-Camissonia-Squid-with.md-23-*Bonito shavings (I didn't add this to the recipe this time, but it's a traditional flavoring that my mom uses) 1/3 cup black vinegar 1/4 cup cornstarch

For the Stock: Pour 2 quarts of water to a stock pot and add chicken powder, cilantro, imitation carb, white pepper, sesame oil, and sugar. Set aside 1/2 cup of the stock to make a cornstarch slurry later on. Bring stock up to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low. Simmer 30-40 minutes.
.tura/media\03-The-Grub-Files-Cooking-with-Camissonia-Squid-with.md-25-2. Add sliced shiitake mushrooms, wood ear fungus, julienned bamboo and carrots to the stock. Simmer for about 20 minutes. At this time, remove the imitation crab from the stock (it's done it's job flavoring the soup, so out it goes - you can still eat it if you like, but I take it out of the soup because it's not a traditional ingredient for the final product).

02 / Knife work

Prep the squid

Pull

Separate head and innards from the mantle in one steady motion.

Trim

Cut below the eyes; keep tentacles, discard beak and innards.

Clean

Remove quill and rinse the cavity. Peel skin only for a pale finish.

Dry

Blot thoroughly. Surface water defeats browning and crisp coatings.

Japan · festival & izakaya tradition

Ikayaki

Soy-glazed grilled whole squid

2010 prep · 10 cook

Ingredients · serves 4

  • 500 g cleaned whole squid
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp mirin
  • 1 tbsp sake
  • 2 tsp grated ginger
  • 1 tsp neutral oil
  • ½ lemon, to serve

Prepare & cook

  1. Score · 5 min. Dry squid; cut shallow lines across mantle without slicing through.
  2. Glaze · 2 min. Mix soy, mirin, sake and ginger; brush over squid.
  3. Grill · 4 min. Oil a very hot grill; cook 2 minutes per side.
  4. Lacquer · 4–6 min. Brush and turn twice more, until lightly charred. Slice and serve with lemon.
Recipe · Asian InspirationsWatch · YouTube 5:06
","","

Korea · everyday home cooking

Ojingeo-bokkeum

Spicy wok-fried squid and vegetables

2214 prep · 8 cook

Ingredients · serves 3

  • 450 g cleaned squid
  • ½ onion, sliced
  • 1 carrot, sliced
  • 3 scallions, cut
  • 1 green chile
  • 3 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp gochugaru
  • 1 tbsp gochujang
  • 2 tbsp rice syrup
  • 5 garlic cloves
  • 2 tsp sesame oil

Prepare & cook

  1. Cut · 8 min. Score mantle, then cut squid and vegetables into bite-size pieces.
  2. Mix · 4 min. Combine soy, chile flakes, paste, syrup, garlic and sesame oil.
  3. Sear · 4 min. Stir-fry vegetables in a hot oiled pan until barely tender.
  4. Flash · 3–4 min. Add squid and sauce; toss hard just until opaque and curled.
Recipe · MaangchiWatch · YouTube 16:16
","","

Cantonese Chinese · dai pai dong tradition

Salt & pepper squid

Crisp-coated squid with fried aromatics

3525 prep · 10 cook

Ingredients · serves 4

  • 450 g squid, rings
  • 80 ml whole milk
  • 65 g plain flour
  • 65 g cornstarch
  • 1 tsp sea salt
  • ¾ tsp white pepper
  • 750 ml frying oil
  • 4 garlic cloves
  • 1 green chile
  • 2 scallions

Prepare & cook

  1. Soak · 20 min. Toss dry squid with milk; meanwhile combine flour, starch, salt and pepper.
  2. Coat · 3 min. Drain well and press squid into the dry mixture.
  3. Fry · 4 min. At 190°C, fry in small batches for 60–90 seconds; drain.
  4. Finish · 2 min. Fry garlic, chile and scallion briefly; toss with squid and season.
Recipe · The Woks of LifeWatch · YouTube 13:24
","","

Taiwan · san bei tradition

Three-cup squid

Rice wine, soy and sesame reduction

2012 prep · 8 cook

Ingredients · serves 3

  • 1 large squid
  • 1 tbsp sesame oil
  • 1 tbsp rice wine
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp mirin
  • 10 garlic cloves
  • 10–12 ginger slices
  • 1 red chile
  • 2 scallions
  • 1 handful Thai basil

Prepare & cook

  1. Blanch · 1 min. Score and cut squid; blanch 30 seconds and drain dry.
  2. Bloom · 3 min. Warm sesame oil; fry ginger, garlic and chile until fragrant.
  3. Reduce · 3 min. Add squid, soy, wine and mirin; toss over high heat until glossy.
  4. Perfume · 1 min. Fold in scallions and basil; cover 30 seconds, then serve.
Recipe · Cook1CookWatch · YouTube 6:38
","","

Cantonese Chinese · home-style steaming

Steamed garlic squid

Squid and glass noodles with ginger sauce

2315 prep · 8 cook

Ingredients · serves 3

  • 500 g squid
  • 60 g glass noodles
  • 5 garlic cloves
  • 1 tbsp minced ginger
  • 2 tbsp light soy
  • 1 tbsp oyster sauce
  • 1 tsp sugar
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 2 scallions

Prepare & cook

  1. Soak · 10 min. Soften noodles in warm water; drain and spread on a heatproof plate.
  2. Arrange · 3 min. Score squid, cut into pieces and set over noodles.
  3. Sauce · 2 min. Mix garlic, ginger, soy, oyster sauce, sugar and sesame oil; spoon over.
  4. Steam · 6–8 min. Steam over rapidly boiling water until squid just turns opaque. Add scallion.
Recipe · What To Cook TodayWatch · YouTube 4:39
","","

Japan · nimono tradition

Ika daikon

Squid and radish in seasoned dashi

4515 prep · 30 cook

Ingredients · serves 2

  • 100 g squid
  • 400 g daikon
  • 20 g ginger
  • 300 ml dashi
  • 50 ml sake
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp sugar
  • 1 tbsp vegetable oil
  • to taste yuzu peel

Prepare & cook

  1. Cut · 10 min. Peel daikon into 2 cm half-moons; score squid and cut into strips.
  2. Brown · 4 min. Sauté daikon in oil until its edges turn translucent.
  3. Simmer · 20 min. Add dashi, sake, soy, sugar and ginger; cover and cook daikon gently.
  4. Finish · 4–5 min. Add squid only at the end. Rest 5 minutes; garnish with yuzu.
Recipe · NHK World-JapanWatch · YouTube 10:58
","","

Korea · muchim side-dish tradition

Ojingeo muchim

Blanched squid in a sweet-sour chile dressing

2520 prep · 5 cook

Ingredients · serves 4

  • 1 large squid, 350 g
  • 1 cucumber
  • ¼ onion
  • 2 scallions
  • 1 green chile
  • 2 tbsp gochujang
  • 2 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 1½ tbsp sugar
  • 1 tbsp corn syrup
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 1 tsp sesame seeds

Prepare & cook

  1. Salt · 10 min. Slice cucumber; salt lightly, rest, then squeeze dry. Slice aromatics.
  2. Blanch · 1 min. Lower scored squid into boiling water for 45–60 seconds; chill and drain.
  3. Dress · 3 min. Whisk gochujang, vinegar, sugar, syrup and sesame oil.
  4. Toss · 2 min. Combine squid and vegetables just before serving; scatter sesame.
Recipe · Korean BapsangWatch · YouTube 6:52
","","

Korea · buchimgae tradition

Squid buchimgae

East Asian cooking field guide

Squid,
ten ways.

From festival grill smoke to a quiet dashi simmer: ten techniques, four culinary traditions, one exacting ingredient.

15 slides · recipes serve 2–4 · quantities follow the linked sources or are cleanly scaled from them.

01 / Orientation

The method atlas

  • JPGrill · simmer · stuff & braise3 dishes
  • KRStir-fry · blanch & toss · griddle-fry3 dishes
  • CNDeep-fry · steam2 dishes
  • TWReduce · soup2 dishes

02 / Knife work

Prep the squid

Pull

Separate head and innards from the mantle in one steady motion.

Trim

Cut below the eyes; keep tentacles, discard beak and innards.

Clean

Remove quill and rinse the cavity. Peel skin only for a pale finish.

Dry

Blot thoroughly. Surface water defeats browning and crisp coatings.

03 / Texture logic

Heat is the choice

Squid is tender at the edges of time: cook it very fast, or let it relax slowly.

  • 0–2 minFlash cooktender snap
  • 3–15 minAvoid the middlerubbery
  • 25–60 minGentle braisesilky again

Japan · festival & izakaya tradition

Ikayaki

Soy-glazed grilled whole squid

2010 prep · 10 cook

Ingredients · serves 4

  • 500 g cleaned whole squid
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp mirin
  • 1 tbsp sake
  • 2 tsp grated ginger
  • 1 tsp neutral oil
  • ½ lemon, to serve

Prepare & cook

  1. Score · 5 min. Dry squid; cut shallow lines across mantle without slicing through.
  2. Glaze · 2 min. Mix soy, mirin, sake and ginger; brush over squid.
  3. Grill · 4 min. Oil a very hot grill; cook 2 minutes per side.
  4. Lacquer · 4–6 min. Brush and turn twice more, until lightly charred. Slice and serve with lemon.
Recipe · Asian InspirationsWatch · YouTube 5:06

Korea · everyday home cooking

Ojingeo-bokkeum

Spicy wok-fried squid and vegetables

2214 prep · 8 cook

Ingredients · serves 3

  • 450 g cleaned squid
  • ½ onion, sliced
  • 1 carrot, sliced
  • 3 scallions, cut
  • 1 green chile
  • 3 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp gochugaru
  • 1 tbsp gochujang
  • 2 tbsp rice syrup
  • 5 garlic cloves
  • 2 tsp sesame oil

Prepare & cook

  1. Cut · 8 min. Score mantle, then cut squid and vegetables into bite-size pieces.
  2. Mix · 4 min. Combine soy, chile flakes, paste, syrup, garlic and sesame oil.
  3. Sear · 4 min. Stir-fry vegetables in a hot oiled pan until barely tender.
  4. Flash · 3–4 min. Add squid and sauce; toss hard just until opaque and curled.
Recipe · MaangchiWatch · YouTube 16:16

Salt & pepper squid

Crisp-coated squid with fried aromatics

3525 prep · 10 cook

Ingredients · serves 4

  • 450 g squid, rings
  • 80 ml whole milk
  • 65 g plain flour
  • 65 g cornstarch
  • 1 tsp sea salt
  • ¾ tsp white pepper
  • 750 ml frying oil
  • 4 garlic cloves
  • 1 green chile
  • 2 scallions

Prepare & cook

  1. Soak · 20 min. Toss dry squid with milk; meanwhile combine flour, starch, salt and pepper.
  2. Coat · 3 min. Drain well and press squid into the dry mixture.
  3. Fry · 4 min. At 190°C, fry in small batches for 60–90 seconds; drain.
  4. Finish · 2 min. Fry garlic, chile and scallion briefly; toss with squid and season.
Recipe · The Woks of LifeWatch · YouTube 13:24

Three-cup squid

Rice wine, soy and sesame reduction

2012 prep · 8 cook

Ingredients · serves 3

  • 1 large squid
  • 1 tbsp sesame oil
  • 1 tbsp rice wine
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp mirin
  • 10 garlic cloves
  • 10–12 ginger slices
  • 1 red chile
  • 2 scallions
  • 1 handful Thai basil

Prepare & cook

  1. Blanch · 1 min. Score and cut squid; blanch 30 seconds and drain dry.
  2. Bloom · 3 min. Warm sesame oil; fry ginger, garlic and chile until fragrant.
  3. Reduce · 3 min. Add squid, soy, wine and mirin; toss over high heat until glossy.
  4. Perfume · 1 min. Fold in scallions and basil; cover 30 seconds, then serve.
Recipe · Cook1CookWatch · YouTube 6:38

Steamed garlic squid

Squid and glass noodles with ginger sauce

2315 prep · 8 cook

Ingredients · serves 3

  • 500 g squid
  • 60 g glass noodles
  • 5 garlic cloves
  • 1 tbsp minced ginger
  • 2 tbsp light soy
  • 1 tbsp oyster sauce
  • 1 tsp sugar
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 2 scallions

Prepare & cook

  1. Soak · 10 min. Soften noodles in warm water; drain and spread on a heatproof plate.
  2. Arrange · 3 min. Score squid, cut into pieces and set over noodles.
  3. Sauce · 2 min. Mix garlic, ginger, soy, oyster sauce, sugar and sesame oil; spoon over.
  4. Steam · 6–8 min. Steam over rapidly boiling water until squid just turns opaque. Add scallion.
Recipe · What To Cook TodayWatch · YouTube 4:39

Ika daikon

Squid and radish in seasoned dashi

4515 prep · 30 cook

Ingredients · serves 2

  • 100 g squid
  • 400 g daikon
  • 20 g ginger
  • 300 ml dashi
  • 50 ml sake
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp sugar
  • 1 tbsp vegetable oil
  • to taste yuzu peel

  1. Cut · 10 min. Peel daikon into 2 cm half-moons; score squid and cut into strips.
  2. Brown · 4 min. Sauté daikon in oil until its edges turn translucent.
  3. Simmer · 20 min. Add dashi, sake, soy, sugar and ginger; cover and cook daikon gently.
  4. Finish · 4–5 min. Add squid only at the end. Rest 5 minutes; garnish with yuzu.
Recipe · NHK World-JapanWatch · YouTube 10:58

Blanched squid in a sweet-sour chile dressing
